SELECT * FROM admin_operation_log
AND module = #{module}
AND (operator_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR action LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR detail LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR target_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND created_at >= #{date} AND created_at < DATE_ADD(#{date}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY created_at DESC, log_id DESC
